name: bitter-lesson
description: Calibrate AI/LLM project scoping, agent architectures, and training plans against live empirical frontier benchmarks and Rich Sutton's Bitter Lesson.

interface.shortDescription: Calibrate AI project scoping and architectures against live frontier capabilities.
interface.longDescription: Prevents models from relying on stale pretraining priors when scoping AI/LLM projects, agent harnesses, or fine-tuning runs. Enforces live empirical benchmark grounding (METR task horizons, Terminal-Bench, open-weight lag) and Rich Sutton's Bitter Lesson.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $bitter-lesson to audit this AI project's goals, architecture, and training assumptions against current frontier capabilities.
